items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: And it was a combination of a jazz quintet and Art Farmer was in it, myself, and symphony orchestra.

ctx.x: Didn’t he write a piece that you performed on also?

Yeah. That was in 1957. The piece was called, curiously enough, “Fusion.” And it’s the first use of that word musically that I’m conscious of. And it was a combination of a jazz quintet and Art Farmer was in it, myself, and symphony orchestra. And it was played by, we performed it with the New York Philharmonic with Leonard Bernstein. So it was fairly well received, it’s a shame it was never recorded.
